text:
Priya: quick brain dump — want feedback before i draft an RFC. thinking of plugging ML-derived abuse/risk signals into admission at the edge. tradeoffs: latency, safety, fairness, privacy.
Ian: agree important. main question: sync per-request call (lowest freshness concerns) vs async enrichment/token refresh (lowest latency). what's our edge SLO?
Priya: aiming for 30ms p95 for auth+admit decision. blocking on a 50–100ms model call is unacceptable for hard decisions. leaning toward hybrid: synchronous local heuristic + async ML token that updates risk state.
Zoe: hybrid makes sense. small quantized model (edge variant) for hot-path soft-decisions, server-side heavy model for higher-fidelity scoring. need automated model rollout and version pinning in sidecars.
Matt: fairness note: model outputs can reflect tenant behavior. if we map score -> quota multiplier blindly we can create systemic bias. any normalization should consider tenant baseline usage and size.
Sanjay: propose a simple ML->admission contract: score, confidence, model_version, ttl_seconds, reason_tags. admission applies a deterministic normalization function per-tenant and enforces safety bounds. keep non-deterministic ML logic out of admit core.
Priya: example API sketch:
```
POST /v1/abuse_score
{ tenant_id, request_id, features? }
=> { score: 0.67, confidence: 0.55, model_version: "abuse-2026-03", ttl_s: 300, tags: ["spam_typo_pattern"] }
```
Priya: ttl_s so edge caches token for a bounded time.
Ian: other attack surface: poisoning / adversarial inputs. need input sanitization, rate-limiting calls to scoring service, and drift monitors. also consider using hashed/feature-only payloads to scoring to reduce PII risk.
Zoe: training pipeline should include adversarial augmentation and a periodic drift check job that alerts when feature distribution diverges. store hashed fingerprints for audits. default to conservative action when confidence < X.
Matt: rollout plan idea: 1) telemetry-only scoring in prod (no decisioning) 2) shadow application with logs 3) enable soft multipliers for small traffic slices 4) full rollout after fairness/regression thresholds met. A/B by tenant cohorts.
Sanjay: telemetry needs: per-tenant histograms of scores, actions, accept/reject rates, latency for scoring and admission. feed these into Optimize for auto-suggestions. include sampling for raw request context retention limited to debugging windows.
Priya: fallback behavior: when ML unavailable, admission should use baseline heuristics and mark events with "ml_fallback" tag. ensure all downstream billing/telemetry reflects fallback.
Ian: deterministic debugability is critical. log model_version + seed + hashed feature vector for requests that change throttle outcome. keep retention strict.
Zoe: infra topology: score engine replicated regionally. reads can be quorum for high-confidence decisions; allow single-replica fast reads for low-risk soft decisions. also provide a sidecar local store for cached tokens.
Matt: privacy: do not send raw user text. send derived features or embeddings, and redact any PII. ensure scoring endpoints require mTLS and KMS for any keys.
ops-bot: deploybot: rolled abuse-2026-03 to staging (3/3 replicas) at 2026-03-24T09:10Z :white_check_mark:
Priya: extra safety: define safety floor so ML cannot reduce a tenant's baseline quota below Y% without human in loop. add manual override and audit trail.
Ian: add feature: /v1/abuse_sanity that admission can call to fetch current multipliers and confidence for a tenant (cached at edge).
Sanjay: add offline replay job to simulate 14d of traffic and output fairness/regression report and cost delta. include synthetic adversarial bursts.
Zoe: include model refresh cadence: daily small-model distros for edge, weekly full-model retrain with human review. document rollback playbook.
Matt: monitoring thresholds: alert if score distribution shifts by more than Z sigma in 1h, or if rejection rate increases >2x in 30m for any tenant.
Priya: great. i'll assemble RFC with sections: API contract, cache TTLs, edge sidecar model plan, normalization/guardrails, rollout steps, telemetry schema, privacy & retention, replay/simulation jobs, and human review gates. posting draft in #eng-platform tomorrow AM.
